Goa Dental Solutions

A connected dental-care experience for patients and practitioners. Appointments, treatment information, and communication come together in one mobile platform.

Patients can manage appointments, receive reminders, view treatment plans and billing, and access oral-care resources. Doctors can organise patient records, treatment plans, virtual prescriptions, and remote communication.
